caption:
American tech companies have made billions by employing cheap labour in India.

But now that AI is entering the picture, it feels like we're being left behind.

Microsoft is offering voluntary exits to 60,000 employees globally, including eligible employees in India, despite making record profits.

And I'm worried about what this could mean for India's real estate market, especially Bangalore.

Property prices have shot up on the back of high-paying IT jobs.

In 2022, just 11% of homes sold in Bangalore cost over ₹1.5 crore. Today, that figure is 62%.

A lot of young professionals have taken on massive home loans assuming their salaries will keep growing.

But what happens when the very companies that made these homes affordable start cutting jobs?

Buying a home on a loan just isn’t worth it in this economy.
